title: Order the card against the U-curve
summary: Highest-value records at the start and end, low-value buried in the middle — one sort, zero tokens, cheapest item in the arc.
description:
Given the U-shaped position curve — accuracy highest at the beginning and end of context, degrading >30% in the middle — arrange the packed set so the highest-value records occupy both edges. Implement as an ordering pass after ASMB-2's selection: sort by value, then interleave outward-in so ranks 1, 3, 5… fill from the front and 2, 4, 6… from the back.

This constrains and is constrained by ASMB-4's prefix stability requirement, and the two must be designed together rather than sequentially — see that story for the resolution.

Acceptance: ordering is deterministic given the same input set; measured on LongMemEval with U-curve ordering on and off (this is a small effect and needs enough trials to distinguish it from noise — say so in the result rather than reporting a single run); the ordering strategy is pluggable so the interleave can be replaced without touching selection. Depends on ASMB-2.
